notes.title: Everyone in the ranking!
notes.notes:
Previously, the ranking had 16 places for you to conquer and appear among the best.
Now, everyone can participate in the ranking and appear in the Chimp Memory home menu!
In a ladder from highest to lowest in score, just scroll down to see all the competitors.
